title: Continual Learning
description: Continual learning: Learn new tasks without forgetting old (catastrophic forgetting prevention). Lifelong learning, incremental learning. EWC, LwF, replay buffers. Online learning.

content.level0_basic: Continual Learning (Lifelong Learning): Model learns new tasks sequentially without forgetting old. Problem: Catastrophic forgetting (neural networks forget Task 1 when learning Task 2). Example: Chatbot learns Spanish after English → forgets English! Robot learns new environments → forgets old. Solution approaches: (1) Replay (store old data, rehearse), (2) Regularization (protect important weights, EWC), (3) Dynamic architecture (expand network). Benefits: Lifelong learning (human-like), data efficiency (no retrain from scratch).
content.level1_beginner: Methods: (1) Replay-based (Experience Replay, GEM, A-GEM, store exemplars), (2) Regularization-based (EWC: Elastic Weight Consolidation, protect important weights via Fisher information; SI: Synaptic Intelligence), (3) Architecture-based (Progressive Neural Networks: add columns per task; DEN: Dynamic Expandable Network), (4) Meta-learning-based (MAML for continual, learn initialization). Task boundaries: Task-incremental (task ID known), class-incremental (no task ID, harder), domain-incremental (same classes, different domains). Evaluation: Average accuracy (all tasks), backward transfer (old task performance), forward transfer (new task learning speed).
content.level2_application: Use cases: (1) Chatbots (learn new intents incrementally), (2) Recommendation (user preferences evolve), (3) Robotics (new environments, tasks), (4) Computer vision (new classes, domains), (5) Medical diagnosis (new diseases, rare conditions). Deployment: Online learning (streaming data), edge devices (model update OTA). Challenges: Class imbalance (new classes few samples), task similarity (negative transfer), memory constraints (limited replay buffer). Frameworks: Avalanche (PyTorch), Continuum, FACIL.
content.level3_advanced: Advanced: (1) Task-free continual learning (no task boundaries, detect drift), (2) Online continual learning (single-pass, no replay), (3) Few-shot continual learning (new tasks with few examples), (4) Multi-modal continual learning (vision + language), (5) Fairness (avoid bias amplification), (6) Uncertainty estimation (when to expand network). Techniques: Gradient episodic memory (GEM), PackNet (prune and pack), HAT (hard attention to task). Theoretical: Stability-plasticity dilemma, capacity limits, forgetting analysis.
content.level4_expert: Production: Model versioning (task timeline), replay buffer management (storage limits, sampling strategy), catastrophic forgetting metrics (monitor old task accuracy), dynamic architecture (auto-expand triggers), privacy (replay buffer encryption). Research: Neuroscience-inspired (complementary learning systems), meta-continual learning, curriculum learning, compositional learning. Benchmarks: CORe50, Stream-51, Continual CIFAR-10/100, Permuted MNIST. Open problems: Backward transfer (improve old tasks), task interference, scalability (1000+ tasks).
